# Instrument Modification

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:InstrumentModification`](gmeow-InstrumentModification.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/InstrumentModification>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

A modification applied to an instrument in an [`InstrumentConfiguration`](gmeow-InstrumentConfiguration.md) — prepared, scordatura, capo, mute, electrified, extended range, etc. An open value vocabulary of individuals; never subclassed ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:InstrumentModification`](gmeow-InstrumentModification.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
